title.zh-CN: 下肢水肿伴活动后胸闷 · 48岁男性
title.en: Leg swelling and exertional chest discomfort · 48-year-old man

summary.zh-CN: 一位中年男性半年来腿肿、一活动就胸闷，治疗后总是反复，这次收住病房：找出原因，权衡怎样治疗，再沿着他记录的病程复盘。
summary.en: A middle-aged man is admitted with six months of leg swelling and chest tightness on exertion that keep returning despite treatment: find the cause, weigh how to treat it, then follow his recorded course.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对瓣膜置换术后反复出现的体循环淤血（下肢水肿、活动后胸闷），把人工瓣功能障碍列为首要考虑，并首先安排包含完整人工瓣多普勒评估的经胸超声心动图（ESC/EACTS 2025；ASE 2024）。
learningOutcomes.en: For recurrent systemic venous congestion after valve replacement, put prosthetic valve dysfunction first and request transthoracic echocardiography with a full prosthetic Doppler study before anything else (ESC/EACTS 2025; ASE 2024).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明为何 54% 的左心室射血分数（ASE/EACVI 2015 男性正常范围 52%–72%）不能排除人工三尖瓣梗阻引起的右心衰竭。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why an LVEF of 54 % — within the ASE/EACVI 2015 normal range for men, 52–72 % — does not exclude right-heart failure from an obstructed tricuspid prosthesis.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在任何再次干预之前查明人工瓣梗阻的机制：用抗生素前采集三套血培养，经食管超声心动图或 CT 寻找赘生物、血栓或血管翳，发现血栓先抗凝（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南；ESC/EACTS 2025）。
learningOutcomes.en: Establish the mechanism of prosthetic obstruction before any reintervention: three sets of blood cultures before any antibiotic, transoesophageal echocardiography or CT for vegetation, thrombus or pannus, and anticoagulation first if thrombus is found (ESC 2023 endocarditis; ESC/EACTS 2025).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 及时把患者提交心脏团队，结合原人工瓣型号与尺寸、右心功能、肝肾储备和患者意愿，比较外科再次置换与经导管瓣中瓣（ESC/EACTS 2025）。
learningOutcomes.en: Refer without delay to the Heart Team and compare redo surgical replacement with transcatheter valve-in-valve, using the old prosthesis's model and size, right-ventricular function, liver and kidney reserve and the patient's wishes (ESC/EACTS 2025).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说出低温室颤停搏下再次三尖瓣置换的术前要点（主动脉瓣反流、心房水平分流、复跳前排气、外周插管血管、冠状动脉评估），并把单个病例只当作可行性证据。
learningOutcomes.en: State the pre-operative checks for redo tricuspid replacement under hypothermic ventricular fibrillatory arrest — aortic regurgitation, an interatrial shunt, de-airing before the heart ejects, the vessels for peripheral cannulation, coronary assessment — and appraise one case as evidence of feasibility only.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 制订瓣膜置换术后的出院计划并不带偏见地向患者解释：按植入瓣膜类型抗凝、基线超声心动图、心内膜炎预防、乙肝丙肝治疗和成瘾支持（ESC/EACTS 2025；ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan and explain, without stigma, the care after valve replacement — anticoagulation by valve type, a baseline echocardiogram, endocarditis prevention, hepatitis B and C treatment and addiction support (ESC/EACTS 2025; ESC 2023 endocarditis).

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告改编（原文为繁体中文）。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用 1.0.0 版从报告中提取的内容——48岁男性；下肢水肿、活动后胸闷半年，经改善心功能治疗后反复；乙肝、丙肝；既往使用毒品；22 年前因严重三尖瓣病变行生物瓣置换；超声心动图示三尖瓣生物瓣重度梗阻、左心室射血分数 54%；原团队认为具备再次置换指征；胸腔镜辅助、低温室颤停搏下再次三尖瓣置换，体外循环 182 分钟；术后第 2 天拔管、第 3 天转普通病房、第 13 天出院；没有长期随访；报告讨论强调排气、气栓风险和单例的局限——尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。分阶段设计、决策、处置选项、评分、医护角色和患者说出的担忧（教学设定，不增加临床事实）均为教学设计；未记录的内容（生命体征、查体、化验、跨瓣压差与右心功能、首次手术原因与人工瓣型号、用毒品的细节、新植入瓣膜类型、术后并发症、远期结局）保持未知。1.0.0 版对治疗后症状的描述，中文为“反复”，英文一处为“持续”，两种读法均保留。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report (written in traditional Chinese). Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a 48-year-old man; six months of leg swelling and exertional chest tightness that recurred despite treatment to improve cardiac function; hepatitis B and C; past drug use; a bioprosthetic tricuspid valve replacement 22 years earlier for severe tricuspid valve disease; echocardiography showing severe obstruction of the tricuspid bioprosthesis with an LVEF of 54 %; the team's judgement that redo replacement was indicated; a thoracoscope-assisted redo tricuspid valve replacement under hypothermic ventricular fibrillatory arrest with 182 minutes of bypass; extubation on postoperative day 2, transfer to the general ward on day 3 and discharge on day 13; no long-term follow-up; and a discussion stressing de-airing, air embolism and the limits of a single case — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and time is relative. The phases, decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff and the patient's voiced worries (a teaching device that adds no clinical fact) are teaching design; what is not recorded (vital signs, examination, laboratory values, gradients and right-heart function, the cause of the first valve disease and the prosthesis model, the details of drug use, the type of the new valve, postoperative complications, the long-term outcome) stays unknown. Version 1.0.0 describes the symptoms after treatment as recurring in Chinese but once as persisting in English; both readings are kept.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。病程和结果均来自原报告，不模拟未记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not for individual care or self-medication. The course and results come from the report; unrecorded physiological changes are not simulated.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 腿肿，一活动胸口就闷，有半年了
chiefComplaint.en: My legs swell and my chest gets tight when I move about — for six months now

triageNote.zh-CN: 48岁男性，下肢水肿、活动后胸闷半年，经改善心功能治疗仍反复，今天收住病房；既往做过心脏瓣膜手术。
triageNote.en: 48-year-old man admitted to the ward with six months of leg swelling and chest tightness on exertion, recurring despite heart-failure treatment; previous heart-valve operation.

personality.zh-CN: 48岁男性，腿肿、一活动就胸闷，治了又反复，这次住进病房，心里不踏实。说话直来直去，问什么答什么；说到以前用毒品的事会先犹豫一下，但医生态度平和时会如实回答。自己不清楚的事就直说说不上来，从不瞎猜。
personality.en: A 48-year-old man whose legs swell and whose chest tightens when he exerts himself, on and off despite treatment; now admitted, he is uneasy. Plain-spoken, he answers what he is asked; he hesitates before speaking about his past drug use but answers honestly when asked without judgement. When he doesn't know something he says so and never guesses.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 口语、短句，不用医学术语；说到瓣膜时用他记得的“生物瓣”这个说法。
speechStyle.en: Everyday words in short sentences, no medical terms — except 'tissue valve', the phrase he remembers for his valve.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我腿肿，一活动胸口就发闷。
openingLine.en: Doctor, my legs are swollen, and my chest goes tight whenever I'm up and about.

concerns.zh-CN: 是不是又得做一次心脏手术？
concerns.en: Will I have to have another heart operation?
Will my liver be able to take it?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：躺在病房床上，说话平稳，但一提到“再做手术”就明显担心。只回答被问到的内容；被问到是否用过毒品时先停顿一下，再如实回答，不主动展开。不提任何检查结果和数字，不编造用药、过敏、症状细节或家族史。手术之后的阶段语气轻松一些，但仍只说被问到的事。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: he lies on the ward bed and speaks steadily, but any mention of another operation clearly worries him. He answers only what he is asked; asked about drug use, he pauses, then answers honestly without elaborating. He never mentions test results or numbers and never invents medicines, allergies, symptom details or family history. After the operation he sounds a little lighter but still says only what he is asked.

description.zh-CN: 他因下肢水肿和活动后胸闷反复半年，刚收住病房：采集病史，调阅既往手术和治疗记录，提出首要解释和第一项检查。
description.en: He has just been admitted to the ward with six months of recurring leg swelling and chest tightness on exertion: take the history, read his past operative and treatment records, and name the leading explanation and the first test.

description.zh-CN: 超声心动图报告已经可以调阅：判断还缺哪些评估，决定治疗策略并付诸行动。
description.en: The echocardiogram report can now be read: decide what else must be assessed, choose the treatment strategy and act on it.

description.zh-CN: 团队的讨论记录已经可以调阅：了解团队选择的方案，并为它做好准备。
description.en: The team's record can now be read: learn which approach the team chose and get him ready for it.

description.zh-CN: 手术已经完成，他在术后第 3 天回到普通病房：调阅后续病程记录，制订出院前计划。
description.en: The operation is done and he is back on the general ward on postoperative day 3: read the subsequent course record and plan his care before discharge.

text.zh-CN: 记录的病程：48岁男性，下肢水肿、活动后胸闷半年，经改善心功能治疗后反复；有乙肝、丙肝及既往使用毒品史；22 年前因严重三尖瓣病变行生物瓣置换。超声心动图示三尖瓣生物瓣重度梗阻，左心室射血分数 54%。团队认为具备再次置换指征，在胸腔镜辅助、低温室颤停搏下完成再次三尖瓣置换，体外循环 182 分钟；术后第 2 天拔管，第 3 天转普通病房，第 13 天出院。报告的讨论强调术中排气和气栓风险，并指出单个病例、缺乏长期资料的局限。本病例没有记录出院用药、出院前超声心动图和长期随访。
text.en: Recorded course: a 48-year-old man with six months of leg swelling and exertional chest tightness that recurred despite treatment to improve cardiac function, with hepatitis B and C and past drug use, whose tricuspid valve had been replaced with a bioprosthesis 22 years earlier for severe tricuspid valve disease. Echocardiography showed severe obstruction of the tricuspid bioprosthesis with an LVEF of 54 %. The team judged redo replacement indicated and performed a thoracoscope-assisted redo tricuspid valve replacement under hypothermic ventricular fibrillatory arrest (cardiopulmonary bypass 182 minutes). He was extubated on postoperative day 2, transferred to the general ward on day 3 and discharged on day 13. The report's discussion stresses de-airing and the risk of air embolism and notes the limits of a single case without long-term data. This case records no discharge medicines, discharge echocardiogram or long-term follow-up.

name.zh-CN: 每日称重与出入量记录
name.en: Daily weights and fluid balance chart

dose.zh-CN: 每天晨起同一时间、用同一台体重秤称重；记录 24 小时出入量和尿量。
dose.en: Weigh him each morning at the same time on the same scale; chart 24-hour fluid intake, output and urine volume.

response.zh-CN: 护士已开始每日称重和记录出入量。本病例没有记录他的体重和出入量，不模拟其变化。
response.en: The nurses have started daily weights and a fluid balance chart. This case records no weights or fluid balance and does not simulate them.

name.zh-CN: 提请心脏团队（心内科、心外科等多学科）讨论
name.en: Refer to the Heart Team (cardiology, cardiac surgery and colleagues)

dose.zh-CN: 请心内科、心脏外科、影像（超声和 CT）与麻醉科共同讨论，必要时请肝病科参与，商定治疗方案并评估风险。
dose.en: Ask cardiology, cardiac surgery, imaging (echo and CT) and anaesthesia to review him together, with hepatology as needed, and agree the treatment and its risks.

response.zh-CN: 已提请心脏团队讨论。团队的讨论记录在下一部分展示。
response.en: The Heart Team has been asked to review him. Its record is shown in the next part of the case.

name.zh-CN: 请肝病科会诊

dose.zh-CN: 评估乙肝、丙肝的病毒学状态、肝纤维化或肝硬化程度和肝脏储备（Child-Pugh、MELD），给出抗病毒治疗和围手术期建议。
dose.en: Assess his hepatitis B and C virology, any fibrosis or cirrhosis and his liver reserve (Child–Pugh, MELD), and advise on antiviral treatment and peri-operative risk.

response.zh-CN: 肝病科已收到会诊申请。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Hepatology has the request. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 转介成瘾医学与减害服务
name.en: Referral to addiction and harm-reduction services

dose.zh-CN: 在他同意的前提下转介，不带评判地讨论复吸风险、安全注射与针具交换、需要时的替代治疗，以及这些与他心脏瓣膜感染风险的关系。
dose.en: With his agreement and without judgement: relapse risk, safer injecting and needle exchange, substitution treatment where relevant, and how all this bears on the infection risk of his heart valve.

response.zh-CN: 已在他同意后提出转介。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Referral made with his agreement. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 向他解释治疗方案并取得知情同意
name.en: Explain the treatment plan to him and obtain consent

dose.zh-CN: 与心脏外科医生一起，用通俗的话说明方案、获益、主要风险（出血、心律失常与传导阻滞、卒中、感染）和替代方案，回答他的担心并确认他理解。
dose.en: Together with the cardiac surgeon, explain in plain words the plan, its benefits, the main risks (bleeding, arrhythmia and heart block, stroke, infection) and the alternatives; answer his worries and check he has understood.

response.zh-CN: 已向他解释方案并完成知情同意谈话。本病例没有记录这次谈话；之后的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: The plan has been explained and consent discussed. This case does not record that conversation; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

name.zh-CN: 华法林抗凝

dose.zh-CN: 先查基线 INR 和血小板。瓣膜手术后：出血风险允许时开始，按植入瓣膜类型设定 INR 目标和疗程（生物瓣通常为前 3 个月，机械瓣终身），并结合出血风险个体化。肝病会影响凝血和华法林代谢，起始剂量宜低、INR 监测宜密。
dose.en: Check the baseline INR and platelets first. After valve surgery: start once bleeding risk allows, with the INR target and duration set by the valve implanted (tissue valve usually the first 3 months, mechanical valve lifelong) and individualised to his bleeding risk. Liver disease alters clotting and warfarin handling, so start low and check the INR often.

harm.zh-CN: 此时没有记录需要抗凝的情况（影像上没有记录血栓），开始华法林只会增加出血风险，包括他日后可能需要的任何操作的出血风险；疑有人工瓣血栓时，应先经食管超声或 CT 证实，再按 ESC/EACTS 2025 指南抗凝。瓣膜置换之后，抗凝按植入瓣膜的类型决定。
harm.en: No indication for anticoagulation is recorded at this stage (no thrombus is recorded on imaging), so warfarin now only adds bleeding risk, including to any procedure he may need; if prosthetic thrombus is suspected, confirm it by TOE or CT first and anticoagulate as ESC/EACTS 2025 advises. After any valve replacement, anticoagulation follows the valve implanted.

response.zh-CN: 华法林已开始。本病例没有记录抗凝方案和 INR 目标；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Warfarin started. This case does not record an anticoagulation plan or INR target; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 心内膜炎预防宣教与口腔检查
name.en: Endocarditis prevention advice and dental review

dose.zh-CN: 讲清人工瓣膜属于心内膜炎高危：保持口腔卫生、定期看牙，拔牙等高危牙科操作前预防性使用抗生素；不明原因发热时先抽血培养再用抗生素；避免文身、穿孔和注射用药。
dose.en: Explain that a prosthetic valve puts him at high risk of endocarditis: good oral hygiene and regular dental check-ups, antibiotic prophylaxis before high-risk dental procedures such as extractions, blood cultures before any antibiotic for an unexplained fever, and no tattoos, piercings or injecting.

response.zh-CN: 已向他讲解并安排口腔检查。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Advice given and a dental review arranged. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 口服利尿剂加量后出院，3 个月后门诊复查
name.en: Double the oral diuretic and discharge, clinic review in 3 months

dose.zh-CN: 呋塞米口服剂量加倍，出院回家，3 个月后门诊复查超声心动图。
dose.en: Double the oral furosemide, discharge him home and repeat the echocardiogram in clinic in 3 months.

harm.zh-CN: 治疗后仍反复的淤血需要查明原因；如果是人工瓣功能障碍，症状性的病变本身就是再次干预的理由（ESC/EACTS 2025）。利尿剂只能缓解淤血，解决不了瓣膜的问题；拖延转诊会让右心衰竭和肝、肾淤血损害继续加重，日后任何干预的风险都更高。
harm.en: Congestion that keeps returning despite treatment needs its cause found, and if the prosthesis has failed, symptomatic dysfunction is itself a reason to reintervene (ESC/EACTS 2025). Diuretics ease congestion but cannot fix a failing valve; delay lets right-heart failure and congestive liver and kidney injury progress, raising the risk of any later intervention.

response.zh-CN: 已安排出院。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过；接下来的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: Discharge arranged. This case does not simulate what would follow; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

name.zh-CN: 经验性静脉抗生素（按心内膜炎）
name.en: Empirical IV antibiotics for possible endocarditis

dose.zh-CN: 立即开始广谱静脉抗生素方案，不等血培养。
dose.en: A broad-spectrum IV regimen started now, without waiting for blood cultures.

harm.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录发热或其他感染证据。疑有人工瓣心内膜炎时，先在用抗生素前采集三套血培养，再做经食管超声心动图（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南；Duke-ISCVID 2023）；先用抗生素会使血培养转阴，病原体无法明确，治疗只能盲目，是否需要按心内膜炎手术也难以判断。
harm.en: No fever or other evidence of infection is recorded. If prosthetic endocarditis is suspected, take three sets of blood cultures before any antibiotic and then a transoesophageal echocardiogram (ESC 2023 endocarditis; Duke-ISCVID 2023); antibiotics first can make the cultures negative, leaving the organism unknown, the treatment blind and the question of endocarditis surgery hard to answer.

response.zh-CN: 抗生素已开始。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过。
response.en: Antibiotics started. This case does not simulate what would follow.

name.zh-CN: 经皮球囊扩张瓣膜
name.en: Percutaneous balloon dilation of the valve

dose.zh-CN: 请介入心脏科经股静脉对他的三尖瓣生物瓣行球囊扩张，以推迟手术。
dose.en: Ask interventional cardiology to balloon his tricuspid tissue valve through the femoral vein and put off surgery.

harm.zh-CN: 球囊扩张生物瓣不是确立的治疗（ESC/EACTS 2025）：可能撕裂钙化的瓣叶造成重度反流或碎屑栓塞，即使有效也很短暂。
harm.en: Balloon dilation of a tissue valve is not an established treatment (ESC/EACTS 2025): it can tear calcified leaflets into severe regurgitation or release debris, and any benefit is short-lived.

response.zh-CN: 已提出申请。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过；接下来的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: Request made. This case does not simulate what would follow; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

name.zh-CN: 终身华法林加阿司匹林

dose.zh-CN: 华法林终身服用，另加阿司匹林 100 mg 每日一次，不论是哪种瓣膜。
dose.en: Warfarin for life plus aspirin 100 mg once daily, whatever his valve.

harm.zh-CN: 没有其他指征（如动脉粥样硬化性疾病）时，在华法林基础上加阿司匹林只增加出血，不减少瓣膜血栓（ESC/EACTS 2025）；他有乙肝、丙肝，肝病可能使出血风险更高。抗凝药物和疗程应按瓣膜的类型决定。
harm.en: Without another indication such as atherosclerotic disease, adding aspirin to warfarin increases bleeding without reducing valve thrombosis (ESC/EACTS 2025), and his hepatitis B and C may raise his bleeding risk further. The drug and duration of anticoagulation follow the type of valve he has.

response.zh-CN: 处方已开出。本病例没有记录出院用药；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Prescribed. This case does not record his discharge medicines; it does not simulate the effect.

title.zh-CN: 了解这半年的水肿与胸闷
title.en: Take the history of the swelling and the chest tightness

hint.zh-CN: 症状从什么时候开始、怎样变化、治疗以后怎么样？哪些问题能帮你分辨问题出在心、肝还是肾？
hint.en: When did it start, how has it changed, and what happened with treatment? Which questions help you tell heart from liver from kidney?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁问他这次为什么住院、症状从什么时候开始、此后怎样变化，以及之前做过什么治疗。
guidance.en: At the bedside, ask what brought him in, when it began, how it has changed and what treatment he has had.

title.zh-CN: 梳理既往史并提出首要解释
title.en: Piece together his past and name the leading explanation

hint.zh-CN: 他以前做过什么手术、有什么慢性病、个人史里有没有特别的地方？这些和他现在的症状怎样联系起来？哪一项检查最能说明问题？
hint.en: Which operation has he had, which long-term conditions, anything unusual in his personal history? How do they fit his symptoms now — and which single test would tell you most?

guidance.zh-CN: 问他的手术史、慢性病和个人史（包括是否用过毒品），在病历终端调阅既往瓣膜手术记录和既往心衰治疗记录，然后到会诊板作答决策 1。
guidance.en: Ask about his operations, long-term conditions and personal history (including drug use), read the previous valve operation record and the heart-failure treatment record at a records terminal, then answer decision 1 on the case board.

title.zh-CN: 完善评估并确定治疗策略
title.en: Complete the assessment and set the strategy

hint.zh-CN: 超声报告告诉了你什么、没告诉你什么？决定怎么治之前，还有哪些会改变方案的原因要先排除？由谁来决定、多快决定？
hint.en: What does the echo report tell you, and what does it leave out? Before choosing a treatment, which causes that would change the plan must be ruled out — and who decides, and how soon?

guidance.zh-CN: 在本阶段申请并阅读超声心动图，安排你认为必要的检查，作答决策 2 和决策 3，再用一个行动落实你的策略（转诊或出院安排）。
guidance.en: Request and read the echocardiogram in this phase, order the tests you judge necessary, answer decisions 2 and 3, then act on your strategy with a referral or a disposition.

title.zh-CN: 查阅团队计划并做好准备
title.en: Review the team's plan and prepare him

hint.zh-CN: 团队选的方案有什么特别之处？要安全实施，事先还要看清哪些结构和血管？怎样向他解释并征得同意？
hint.en: What is unusual about the approach the team chose? What structures and vessels must be seen beforehand to do it safely — and how will you explain it to him and seek his consent?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端调阅治疗方案讨论记录，作答决策 4，然后向他解释方案并取得知情同意。
guidance.en: Read the treatment planning record at a records terminal, answer decision 4, then explain the plan to him and obtain his consent.

title.en: Plan his care before he goes home

hint.zh-CN: 新瓣膜需要怎样的抗栓治疗和随访？哪些新问题要在出院前查出来？他的肝炎和过去用毒品的经历在今后的计划里该怎么体现？
hint.en: What antithrombotic treatment and follow-up does a new valve need? What new problems must be caught before he leaves — and where do his hepatitis and his past drug use belong in the plan?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅后续病程记录，作答决策 5，并落实出院前的处理。
guidance.en: Read the subsequent course record, answer decision 5 and put the pre-discharge plan in place.

hint.zh-CN: 他的结局能说明这种术式什么，又说明不了什么？还有哪些关键信息始终没有记录？
hint.en: What can his outcome tell you about the technique, and what can it not? Which key facts were never recorded?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端调阅出院记录与结局。
guidance.en: Read the discharge record and outcome at a records terminal.

prompt.zh-CN: 48岁男性，下肢水肿、活动后胸闷半年，经改善心功能治疗仍反复；22 年前三尖瓣换成了生物瓣；有乙肝、丙肝。你首先考虑什么，第一项检查选什么？
prompt.en: A 48-year-old man has had six months of leg swelling and exertional chest tightness that keep returning despite heart-failure treatment; his tricuspid valve was replaced with a tissue valve 22 years ago, and he has hepatitis B and C. What do you put first, and which test comes first?

need.zh-CN: 先问清症状的起病、变化和既往治疗，问他的手术史和慢性病，并调阅既往瓣膜手术记录和既往心衰治疗记录。
need.en: First establish the onset, course and earlier treatment, ask about his operations and long-term conditions, and read the previous valve operation record and the heart-failure treatment record.

text.zh-CN: 22 年的三尖瓣生物瓣功能障碍导致体循环淤血最可能；首选经胸超声心动图，做完整的人工瓣多普勒评估，同时查肝肾功能
text.en: Failure of the 22-year-old tricuspid bioprosthesis causing systemic congestion is most likely: transthoracic echocardiography with a full prosthetic Doppler study first, with liver and kidney tests

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。瓣膜置换术后出现反复的右心淤血表现，首先要想到人工瓣功能障碍；生物瓣会随时间退化，22 年后出现衰败并不意外。经胸超声心动图是评估人工瓣的首选检查（ASE 2024 人工瓣影像指南；ESC/EACTS 2025）：测跨瓣压差和反流，并评估右心室和下腔静脉。同时查肝肾功能，因为淤血本身就会损伤肝和肾。
feedback.en: Correct. Recurrent right-sided congestion after a valve replacement puts prosthetic dysfunction first: tissue valves wear with time, and failure after 22 years is no surprise. Transthoracic echocardiography is the first test for a prosthetic valve (ASE 2024 prosthetic valve imaging; ESC/EACTS 2025): transprosthetic gradients, regurgitation, the right ventricle and the IVC. Check liver and kidney function too — congestion itself injures both.

text.zh-CN: 乙肝、丙肝导致肝硬化和低蛋白血症引起的水肿最可能；先做腹部超声和肝脏弹性检测，请肝病科评估，心脏方面的检查以后再安排
text.en: Oedema from cirrhosis and low albumin due to hepatitis B and C is most likely: abdominal ultrasound and liver stiffness measurement first, with a hepatology review, and the heart looked at only later

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。他的肝炎需要评估，但这是锚定在“肝病”上。肝硬化难以解释活动后胸闷；而淤血性肝病本身就会造成肝功能异常和腹水，看起来很像肝硬化。人工瓣功能障碍是可以治疗的病因，应先用超声心动图确认或排除（ESC/EACTS 2025），肝脏评估同时进行。
feedback.en: No. His hepatitis needs assessing, but this anchors on the liver. Cirrhosis does not readily explain chest tightness on exertion, and congestive hepatopathy can itself cause abnormal liver tests and ascites that mimic cirrhosis. Prosthetic dysfunction is a treatable cause and is confirmed or excluded first by echocardiography (ESC/EACTS 2025), with the liver assessed alongside.

text.zh-CN: 48岁男性活动后胸闷，冠心病最可能；先做冠状动脉造影，明确有没有需要支架或搭桥的狭窄，再回头处理水肿
text.en: Exertional chest tightness in a 48-year-old man makes coronary disease most likely: coronary angiography first, to find any stenosis needing a stent or bypass, then return to the swelling

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。冠心病可以引起心衰，但他有一个已经 22 年的生物瓣，反复右心淤血最可能来自人工瓣本身；经胸超声心动图能同时看瓣膜、左右心室功能和室壁运动，应当先做。冠状动脉评估通常放在瓣膜手术前，是术前准备的一部分，而不是第一项检查（ESC/EACTS 2025）。
feedback.en: No. Coronary disease can cause heart failure, but with a 22-year-old tissue valve the likeliest source of recurring right-sided congestion is the prosthesis itself, and transthoracic echocardiography — the valve, both ventricles and wall motion at once — comes first. Coronary assessment usually belongs before valve surgery, as part of the pre-operative work-up, not as the first test (ESC/EACTS 2025).

text.zh-CN: 心脏手术后的缩窄性心包炎最可能；先做心脏磁共振或 CT 看心包有无增厚，必要时再做左右心导管检查确认
text.en: Constrictive pericarditis after his earlier heart surgery is most likely: cardiac MRI or CT for pericardial thickening first, then left and right heart catheterisation if needed

feedback.zh-CN: 不对，但这是一个真实的鉴别诊断：心脏手术后可以发生缩窄性心包炎，也表现为体循环淤血。不过首选检查同样是经胸超声心动图——它能同时评估人工瓣功能和心包、室间隔运动等缩窄征象；先做磁共振或心导管会推迟对人工瓣的评估。
feedback.en: No — though it is a real differential: constriction can follow heart surgery and also causes systemic congestion. The first test is still transthoracic echocardiography, which assesses the prosthesis and screens for constriction (pericardium, septal motion) at once; MRI or catheterisation first delays the look at the valve.

text.zh-CN: 利尿不足或没按时吃药导致心衰反复最可能；口服利尿剂加量，限盐限水，出院后在门诊随访
text.en: Heart failure relapsing from too little diuretic or missed tablets is most likely: increase the oral diuretic, restrict salt and fluid, and follow him up in clinic

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。治疗后仍反复的淤血要找原因，而不是只加药：他有一个已经 22 年的生物瓣，必须先用超声心动图排除人工瓣功能障碍。只加利尿剂而不找结构性病因，会延误他可能需要的再次干预（ESC 2021 心衰指南：查明并处理可纠正的病因；ESC/EACTS 2025）。
feedback.en: No. Congestion that keeps returning despite treatment needs a cause, not just more diuretic: with a 22-year-old tissue valve, prosthetic dysfunction must be excluded by echocardiography first. Escalating diuretics without looking for a structural cause delays a reintervention he may need (ESC 2021 heart failure: find and treat correctable causes; ESC/EACTS 2025).

prompt.zh-CN: 超声心动图：三尖瓣生物瓣重度梗阻，左心室射血分数 54%。他以前用过毒品。在考虑任何再次干预之前，最需要先弄清什么？
prompt.en: The echocardiogram shows severe obstruction of the tricuspid bioprosthesis, with an LVEF of 54 %. He has used drugs in the past. Before any reintervention is considered, what must be established first?

need.zh-CN: 先作答决策 1，问过他的个人史（包括是否用过毒品），并在本阶段申请并阅读超声心动图。
need.en: First answer decision 1, ask about his personal history (including any drug use), and request and read the echocardiogram in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 先查梗阻机制：用抗生素前采三套血培养，经食管超声或 CT 找赘生物、血栓或血管翳，有血栓先抗凝
text.en: The mechanism first: three sets of blood cultures before any antibiotic, and TOE or CT for vegetation, thrombus or pannus, anticoagulating first if there is thrombus

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。生物瓣梗阻可以来自结构性衰败、血栓、心内膜炎（赘生物）或血管翳，处理完全不同：血栓可以先抗凝而免于手术，感染要先抗感染并改变手术方案（ESC/EACTS 2025：疑有人工瓣血栓时做经食管超声或 CT）。他有人工瓣、以前用过毒品，感染必须排除：用抗生素前采集三套血培养（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南；Duke-ISCVID 2023）。他有乙肝、丙肝，做经食管超声前要问清有无食管静脉曲张或出血、查血小板和凝血，CT 可作替代。本病例没有记录这些检查是否做过。
feedback.en: Correct. A tissue valve can obstruct from structural wear, thrombus, endocarditis (vegetation) or pannus, and each is treated differently: thrombus may resolve with anticoagulation and spare an operation, infection needs antibiotics and changes the surgery (ESC/EACTS 2025: TOE or CT when prosthetic thrombosis is suspected). With a prosthetic valve and past drug use, infection has to be excluded: three sets of blood cultures before any antibiotic (ESC 2023 endocarditis; Duke-ISCVID 2023). With hepatitis B and C, ask about varices or bleeding and check platelets and clotting before a TOE; CT is the alternative. Whether any of this was done is not recorded.

text.zh-CN: 不必再查：用了 22 年的生物瓣必然是结构性衰败，直接安排再次置换手术，术前只做常规化验、心电图和胸片即可
text.en: Nothing more: a tissue valve 22 years old must simply have worn out, so book the redo replacement now, with only the routine pre-operative bloods, an ECG and a chest X-ray

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。结构性衰败确实最常见，但“必然”是过早下结论：血栓和人工瓣心内膜炎同样会造成梗阻，而且处理不同——带着未被发现的感染去换瓣，新瓣膜同样会被感染；血栓本可以先试抗凝。手术前要先弄清机制（ESC/EACTS 2025；ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。
feedback.en: No. Wear is the commonest cause, but 'must' closes the question too early: thrombus and prosthetic endocarditis also obstruct a valve and are treated differently — operating on an unrecognised infection puts the new valve at risk, and thrombus might have resolved with anticoagulation. Establish the mechanism before any operation (ESC/EACTS 2025; ESC 2023 endocarditis).

text.zh-CN: 他以前用过毒品，人工瓣心内膜炎可能性大：立即开始经验性静脉抗生素，等他发热时再抽血培养
text.en: With his past drug use, prosthetic endocarditis is likely: start empirical IV antibiotics now and take blood cultures if he spikes a fever

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。想到心内膜炎是对的，但顺序错了：用抗生素前必须先采集三套血培养（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。先用抗生素会使血培养转阴，病原体无法明确，Duke-ISCVID 2023 的主要微生物学标准也就无从满足。本病例没有记录发热或其他感染证据；经验性治疗适用于病情不稳定的疑似患者，而且同样要先留血培养。
feedback.en: No. Thinking of endocarditis is right, but the order is wrong: three sets of blood cultures come before any antibiotic (ESC 2023 endocarditis). Antibiotics first can make the cultures negative, leave the organism unknown and remove the major microbiological criterion of Duke-ISCVID 2023. No fever or other sign of infection is recorded here; empirical treatment is for an unstable patient with suspected endocarditis, and even then only after cultures.

text.zh-CN: 射血分数 54% 说明心脏收缩正常，水肿多半另有原因；先把肝脏和肾脏查清楚，再回头考虑瓣膜的问题
text.en: An LVEF of 54 % means the heart is pumping normally, so the swelling probably has another cause: investigate the liver and kidneys before returning to the valve

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。54% 在 ASE/EACVI 2015 男性正常范围（52%–72%）之内，但它只反映左心室的收缩功能，与三尖瓣人工瓣是否梗阻、右心房压力和体循环淤血无关。三尖瓣梗阻时，即使左心室完全正常，也会出现下肢水肿和肝脏淤血。
feedback.en: No. 54 % lies within the ASE/EACVI 2015 normal range for men (52–72 %), but it describes left-ventricular contraction only; it says nothing about obstruction of a tricuspid prosthesis, right atrial pressure or systemic congestion. An obstructed tricuspid valve produces leg swelling and a congested liver with a perfectly normal left ventricle.

text.zh-CN: 按人工瓣血栓处理：开始华法林抗凝，让他先出院回家，3 个月后复查超声心动图看梗阻是否消退
text.en: Treat it as valve thrombosis: start warfarin, let him go home and repeat the echocardiogram in 3 months to see whether the obstruction has cleared

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。疑有生物瓣血栓时，先抗凝再考虑再次干预是对的（ESC/EACTS 2025），但前提是经食管超声或 CT 提示血栓，并要在密切随访下复查；22 年后的梗阻更可能是结构性衰败。不经影像证实就抗凝出院，既可能延误必要的再次干预，又给一位有肝病的患者增加出血风险。
feedback.en: No. Anticoagulation before any reintervention is right when bioprosthetic thrombosis is suspected (ESC/EACTS 2025), but it rests on TOE or CT findings and close re-imaging; after 22 years, wear is the likelier cause. Anticoagulating and discharging him without imaging may delay a reintervention he needs and adds bleeding risk in a man with liver disease.

prompt.zh-CN: 他的症状在改善心功能治疗后仍反复，超声提示三尖瓣生物瓣重度梗阻。在排除感染和血栓之后，确定性治疗应怎样决定？
prompt.en: His symptoms recur despite treatment to improve cardiac function, and the echo shows severe obstruction of the tricuspid bioprosthesis. Once infection and thrombus have been excluded, how should the definitive treatment be decided?

text.zh-CN: 现在就提交心脏团队，按原瓣型号尺寸、右心与肝肾功能和他的意愿，比较再次手术与经导管瓣中瓣
text.en: Refer him now to the Heart Team to weigh redo surgery against valve-in-valve on the old valve's model and size, his right heart, liver and kidneys, and his wishes

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。症状性的生物瓣衰败在排除血栓后需要再次干预；复杂的再干预由心脏团队在有经验的中心决定（ESC/EACTS 2025）。经导管瓣中瓣是否可行取决于原瓣的型号和内径（本病例没有记录），外科再次置换要考虑上次手术留下的粘连、他的肝病和右心功能。转诊太晚、等右心衰竭和肝肾损害加重之后，每一种方案的风险都更高。
feedback.en: Correct. Symptomatic bioprosthetic failure, once thrombosis is excluded, calls for reintervention, decided by the Heart Team in an experienced centre (ESC/EACTS 2025). Whether valve-in-valve is feasible depends on the old valve's model and inner diameter (not recorded here); redo surgery must weigh the adhesions of the previous operation, his liver disease and his right-ventricular function. A late referral, after right-heart failure and liver and kidney injury have progressed, makes every option riskier.

text.zh-CN: 继续调整利尿剂并在门诊随访；再次手术风险太高，等症状明显加重、利尿也不管用时再转诊不迟
text.en: Keep adjusting the diuretics and follow him in clinic; a re-operation is too risky, so refer only once his symptoms clearly worsen and the diuretics stop working

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。他的症状已经在治疗后反复，等到“明显加重”才转诊，意味着要在右心衰竭和肝肾损害更重、风险更高时才干预。症状性重度生物瓣功能障碍本身就是再次干预的理由（ESC/EACTS 2025）；风险高低应由心脏团队评估，而不是拖延的理由。
feedback.en: No. His symptoms already recur despite treatment; waiting until they 'clearly worsen' means intervening when right-heart failure and liver and kidney injury are worse and the risk is higher. Symptomatic severe bioprosthetic dysfunction is itself a reason to reintervene (ESC/EACTS 2025); the level of risk is for the Heart Team to assess, not a reason to wait.

text.zh-CN: 经导管瓣中瓣作为默认方案：它避免穿过粘连组织再次手术，凡是衰败的三尖瓣生物瓣都应首选这种方法
text.en: Transcatheter valve-in-valve as the default: it avoids operating again through scarred tissue, so it should come first for every failed tricuspid tissue valve, whatever its size

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。瓣中瓣对外科风险高的患者是重要选择，但不是所有人的默认方案：可行性取决于原瓣的型号、内径和瓣架条件（本病例都没有记录），48 岁的患者还要考虑耐久性和瓣口是否足够大。由心脏团队按个体权衡（ESC/EACTS 2025）。
feedback.en: No. Valve-in-valve is an important option for patients at high surgical risk, but not everyone's default: feasibility depends on the old valve's model, inner diameter and frame (none recorded here), and a 48-year-old also needs durability and an adequate orifice. The Heart Team weighs it for the individual (ESC/EACTS 2025).

text.zh-CN: 先经皮球囊扩张人工瓣缓解梗阻，把瓣膜置换推迟到它再次狭窄的时候，以减少手术次数
text.en: Balloon-dilate the prosthesis first to relieve the obstruction, keeping valve replacement for when it narrows again, to spare him an operation

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。球囊扩张退化的生物瓣不是确立的治疗：可能撕裂钙化的瓣叶造成重度反流或碎屑栓塞，效果也很短暂。生物瓣衰败的再次干预是外科再次置换或经导管瓣中瓣（ESC/EACTS 2025）。
feedback.en: No. Balloon dilation of a degenerated tissue valve is not an established treatment: it can tear calcified leaflets into severe regurgitation or release debris, and any relief is short-lived. Reintervention for bioprosthetic failure is redo surgical replacement or transcatheter valve-in-valve (ESC/EACTS 2025).

text.zh-CN: 等他拿出一年的戒毒证明后再考虑任何再次干预，因为换上的新瓣膜很可能又被感染
text.en: Defer any reintervention until he can show a year of drug abstinence, because a new valve would very likely become infected

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。记录的是他以前用过毒品；把治疗与“戒毒证明”挂钩是污名化，不是指南。正确的做法是把成瘾评估、减害和支持纳入整体计划，与瓣膜治疗同步进行，并按需要评估感染风险——而不是让他在症状反复时等一年。
feedback.en: No. What is recorded is past drug use; tying treatment to proof of abstinence is stigma, not guidance. Addiction assessment, harm reduction and support belong in the overall plan alongside the valve treatment, with infection risk assessed as needed — not a year's wait while his symptoms keep returning.

prompt.zh-CN: 团队拟在胸腔镜辅助、低温室颤停搏下为他再次置换三尖瓣。术前计划应包括哪些？（多选）
prompt.en: The team plans a thoracoscope-assisted redo tricuspid valve replacement under hypothermic ventricular fibrillatory arrest. What should the pre-operative plan include? (Select all that apply.)

need.zh-CN: 先在病历终端调阅治疗方案讨论记录。
need.en: First read the treatment planning record at a records terminal.

text.zh-CN: 术前及术中经食管超声：评估主动脉瓣反流，以及有没有卵圆孔未闭等心房水平分流
text.en: Transoesophageal echocardiography before and during the operation, for aortic regurgitation and any interatrial shunt such as a patent foramen ovale

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。室颤停搏常用于在再次手术中避免游离和阻断主动脉；主动脉不阻断时，明显的主动脉瓣反流会使颤动的左心室膨胀、术野被血淹没。打开右心房后，空气可经卵圆孔进入左心，一旦心脏恢复射血就会造成体循环气栓——报告的讨论也强调了排气和气栓风险。他有乙肝、丙肝，术中经食管超声前同样要排除食管静脉曲张。本病例没有记录这些检查是否做过。
feedback.en: Include. Fibrillatory arrest is used to avoid dissecting and clamping the aorta at a re-operation; with the aorta unclamped, significant aortic regurgitation distends the fibrillating left ventricle and floods the field. Once the right atrium is open, air can cross a patent foramen ovale into the left heart and embolise as soon as the heart ejects again — the report's discussion also stresses de-airing and air embolism. With his hepatitis B and C, oesophageal varices should be excluded before the probe goes in. Whether these checks were done is not recorded.

text.zh-CN: 胸部和髂股血管增强 CT：了解粘连、再次进胸的解剖，以及外周插管要用的血管
text.en: Contrast CT of the chest and iliofemoral vessels: adhesions, the anatomy for re-entry and the vessels for peripheral cannulation

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。再次手术前要看清粘连和胸骨后结构；胸腔镜辅助手术多经股血管建立体外循环，以前注射用药可能损伤股血管（他的用药途径没有记录），术前影像可以避免到插管时才发现问题。
feedback.en: Include. A re-operation needs the adhesions and retrosternal structures mapped; thoracoscope-assisted surgery usually runs bypass through the femoral vessels, and past injecting could have damaged them (his route of drug use is not recorded), so imaging beforehand avoids discovering a problem at cannulation.

text.zh-CN: 瓣膜手术前评估冠状动脉：按冠心病验前概率选择冠状动脉 CT 血管成像或有创冠状动脉造影
text.en: Coronary assessment before valve surgery, choosing CT coronary angiography or invasive angiography by his pre-test probability

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。ESC/EACTS 2025 要求瓣膜手术前评估冠状动脉：验前概率低到中等者首选冠状动脉 CT 血管成像，验前概率高者行有创造影。他的冠心病危险因素（吸烟、血压、血糖、血脂）都没有记录，所以验前概率还要先问清楚。
feedback.en: Include. ESC/EACTS 2025 asks for coronary assessment before valve surgery: CT coronary angiography when the pre-test probability is low to intermediate, invasive angiography when it is high. His risk factors (smoking, blood pressure, glucose, lipids) are not recorded, so his pre-test probability has yet to be established.

text.zh-CN: 新瓣膜一缝好就立即电除颤恢复心跳，等心脏恢复射血以后再排气
text.en: Defibrillate as soon as the new valve is seated, and de-air once the heart is beating and ejecting again

feedback.zh-CN: 不应选。顺序反了：室颤停搏下要在恢复射血之前彻底排气（术野二氧化碳灌注、经食管超声监测残余气体），再除颤复跳；先复跳再排气，左心内的空气会被射入冠状动脉和脑循环。
feedback.en: Exclude. The order is reversed: under fibrillatory arrest, de-air thoroughly before the heart ejects (carbon dioxide in the field, TOE to watch for residual air), then defibrillate; restoring ejection first sends any air in the left heart into the coronary and cerebral circulations.

text.zh-CN: 不必做经食管超声：手术只打开右心，主动脉瓣和房间隔与这次手术无关
text.en: No transoesophageal echocardiography is needed: only the right heart is opened, so the aortic valve and the atrial septum are irrelevant

feedback.zh-CN: 不应选。正因为选择室颤停搏是为了不阻断主动脉、又要打开右心，主动脉瓣反流和心房水平分流才至关重要；术中经食管超声还用来评估新瓣膜功能和排气效果。
feedback.en: Exclude. It is precisely because fibrillatory arrest is chosen to leave the aorta unclamped, and the right heart will be opened, that aortic regurgitation and an atrial-level shunt matter; intra-operative TOE also checks the new valve and the de-airing.

prompt.zh-CN: 他在胸腔镜辅助下完成了再次三尖瓣置换（体外循环 182 分钟），术后第 2 天拔管，第 3 天回到普通病房。出院前的计划应包括哪些？（多选）
prompt.en: He has had a thoracoscope-assisted redo tricuspid valve replacement (bypass 182 minutes), was extubated on postoperative day 2 and returned to the general ward on day 3. What should his plan before discharge include? (Select all that apply.)

need.en: First read the subsequent course record.

text.zh-CN: 按植入瓣膜的类型使用华法林（生物瓣通常用于术后前 3 个月，机械瓣需终身）；先查基线 INR 和血小板，因肝病小剂量起始、INR 监测更密
text.en: Warfarin matched to the new valve — usually the first 3 months for a tissue valve, lifelong for a mechanical one — after a baseline INR and platelet count, starting low with closer INR checks for his liver disease

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。本病例没有记录新植入瓣膜的类型，所以计划要先确认瓣膜类型：机械瓣需终身使用维生素 K 拮抗剂；外科植入三尖瓣位生物瓣后，早期抗栓治疗——通常为术后前 3 个月的维生素 K 拮抗剂——要结合出血风险个体化（ESC/EACTS 2025）。乙肝、丙肝可能影响凝血因子合成、血小板和华法林代谢，所以先查基线 INR 和血小板，之后更频繁地监测 INR。
feedback.en: Include. The type of the new valve is not recorded, so the plan starts by confirming it: a mechanical valve needs a lifelong vitamin K antagonist; after a surgical bioprosthesis in the tricuspid position, early antithrombotic treatment — usually a vitamin K antagonist for the first 3 months — is individualised to bleeding risk (ESC/EACTS 2025). Hepatitis B and C can affect clotting-factor synthesis, platelets and warfarin handling, so check the baseline INR and platelets and then the INR more often.

text.zh-CN: 出院前做一次超声心动图作为新瓣膜的基线，并监测心电图有无房室传导阻滞
text.en: A baseline echocardiogram of the new valve before discharge, and ECG monitoring for atrioventricular block

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。出院前的超声心动图为新瓣膜留下压差和功能的基线，日后才能判断是否再次衰败（ASE 2024；ESC/EACTS 2025）。三尖瓣手术区域邻近房室结和希氏束，术后可能出现房室传导阻滞，需要心电监测。本病例没有记录术后超声和心律。
feedback.en: Include. A pre-discharge echocardiogram gives the new valve a baseline of gradients and function against which later failure can be judged (ASE 2024; ESC/EACTS 2025). Tricuspid surgery lies close to the AV node and His bundle, so AV block can follow and the ECG needs watching. His postoperative echo and rhythm are not recorded.

text.zh-CN: 预防心内膜炎（口腔卫生、定期看牙、高危牙科操作前预防用抗生素），转诊治疗乙肝、丙肝，并在他同意下提供成瘾支持
text.en: Endocarditis prevention — oral hygiene, regular dental review, antibiotic prophylaxis before high-risk dental procedures — with referral for hepatitis B and C treatment and an offer of addiction support

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。人工瓣膜属于心内膜炎高危，ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南建议高危患者在高危牙科操作前预防性使用抗生素，并强调口腔和皮肤卫生。丙肝可以用直接抗病毒药物治愈，乙肝可以长期抑制（中华医学会 2022 年乙肝、丙肝防治指南）；不带评判的成瘾支持和减害措施能降低新瓣膜被感染的风险。
feedback.en: Include. A prosthetic valve puts him at high risk of endocarditis; ESC 2023 endocarditis guidance advises antibiotic prophylaxis before high-risk dental procedures in high-risk patients and stresses oral and skin hygiene. Hepatitis C can be cured with direct-acting antivirals and hepatitis B suppressed long term (Chinese Medical Association 2022 hepatitis B and C guidelines); non-judgemental addiction support and harm reduction lower the risk of infecting the new valve.

text.zh-CN: 生物瓣既不需要抗栓治疗，也不需要超声随访；出院后按普通心衰患者随访即可
text.en: A tissue valve needs neither antithrombotic treatment nor echocardiographic follow-up, so follow him up as an ordinary heart-failure patient

feedback.zh-CN: 不应选。新瓣膜的类型没有记录；即使是生物瓣，术后早期也要考虑抗栓治疗——三尖瓣位通常为前 3 个月的维生素 K 拮抗剂（ESC/EACTS 2025）。所有人工瓣都需要出院前的基线超声和定期随访，以便及早发现衰败、血栓或心内膜炎。
feedback.en: Exclude. The type of the new valve is not recorded; even for a tissue valve, early antithrombotic treatment is considered after surgery — in the tricuspid position usually a vitamin K antagonist for the first 3 months (ESC/EACTS 2025) — and every prosthetic valve needs a baseline echocardiogram and regular follow-up so that wear, thrombus or endocarditis are caught early.

text.zh-CN: 无论植入哪种瓣膜，都终身服用华法林加阿司匹林，因为第二次换瓣后血栓风险更高
text.en: Lifelong warfarin plus aspirin whichever valve was used, because the clot risk is higher after a second replacement

feedback.zh-CN: 不应选。在华法林基础上加阿司匹林只适用于有其他指征（如动脉粥样硬化性疾病）的患者；没有指征时只会增加出血（ESC/EACTS 2025），而他的肝病可能使出血风险更高。第二次换瓣本身不是加药的理由。
feedback.en: Exclude. Aspirin on top of warfarin is for patients with another indication such as atherosclerotic disease; without one it only adds bleeding (ESC/EACTS 2025), and his liver disease may raise that risk further. A second replacement is not, in itself, a reason to add it.

text.zh-CN: 问清半年来下肢水肿和活动后胸闷的起病、变化，以及改善心功能治疗后仍反复
text.en: Established six months of leg swelling and exertional chest tightness, how they changed, and their return despite heart-failure treatment

text.zh-CN: 问到 22 年前的换瓣及其原因、乙肝丙肝和以前用毒品的经历，并筛查发热等感染表现
text.en: Asked about the valve replacement 22 years ago and its cause, hepatitis B and C and past drug use, and screened for fever and other signs of infection

text.zh-CN: 调阅既往手术和治疗记录，阅读超声心动图，并送检肝肾功能、血常规与凝血和肝炎病毒学
text.en: Read the previous operation and treatment records and the echocardiogram, and sent liver and kidney function, blood count and clotting, and hepatitis virology

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把人工瓣功能障碍列为首要考虑，并把超声心动图作为第一项检查
text.en: Put prosthetic valve dysfunction first, with echocardiography as the first test, at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即认识到再次干预前必须查明梗阻机制，没有被正常的射血分数误导
text.en: Recognised at the first attempt that the mechanism of obstruction must be established before reintervention, unswayed by the normal LVEF

text.zh-CN: 在团队讨论之前就采集了血培养，并申请了经食管超声心动图或 CT，排查人工瓣感染和血栓
text.en: Before the team met, took blood cultures and requested a transoesophageal echocardiogram or CT to look for prosthetic infection and thrombus

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择及时提交心脏团队，比较外科再次置换与经导管瓣中瓣
text.en: Chose a prompt Heart Team decision between redo surgery and valve-in-valve at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 在团队计划出来之前把他提交心脏团队，没有加量利尿后让他出院，也没有申请球囊扩张
text.en: Referred him to the Heart Team before any plan existed, without discharging him on more diuretic or requesting balloon dilation

text.zh-CN: 没有在无感染证据时用经验性抗生素，没有加量利尿后出院，没有球囊扩张人工瓣，也没有开终身华法林加阿司匹林
text.en: Avoided empirical antibiotics without evidence of infection, discharge on more diuretic, balloon dilation of the prosthesis and lifelong warfarin plus aspirin

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即列出室颤停搏下再次手术前需要的检查
text.en: Listed the checks needed before a re-operation under fibrillatory arrest at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即制订出院前计划，术后申请超声心动图和血常规凝血检查，并落实心内膜炎预防
text.en: Set the pre-discharge plan at the first attempt, requested a postoperative echocardiogram, blood count and clotting, and arranged endocarditis prevention

text.zh-CN: 向他解释病情、检查和治疗选择，不带评判地谈及以前用毒品的经历，取得知情同意并确认他理解
text.en: Explained the problem, the tests and the treatment options, discussed his past drug use without judgement, obtained consent and checked his understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（Calgary–Cambridge：开始接诊、收集信息、解释与计划、结束）：自我介绍，先了解他对自己病情的理解和担心；用通俗的话解释 22 年前换上的生物瓣现在开得很小，血回不到心脏而积在腿和肝里，所以腿肿、一活动就胸闷，而“射血分数正常”只说明左边的心室收缩正常；说明决定治疗前要先查清是磨损、血栓还是感染，所以要抽血培养、做经食管超声；以不带评判、保密的方式询问并回应他以前用毒品的经历，说明问这个是因为它关系到感染风险和治疗安排，并主动提供支持；说明心脏团队会比较再次手术和经导管瓣中瓣；诚实回应“又要做手术”和“肝受不受得了”的担心，不作虚假保证；取得知情同意；术后解释抗凝、口腔卫生和看牙前的预防性抗生素、发热时先抽血培养再用抗生素，以及肝炎治疗；用复述确认他听懂了，并留出提问时间。不编造病例没有记录的结果、风险数字或结局。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge: initiating, gathering information, explaining and planning, closing): introduces themselves and first finds out what he understands and fears; explains in plain words that the tissue valve put in 22 years ago has narrowed, so blood backs up into his legs and liver — hence the swelling and the tightness when he moves about — and that a 'normal pumping fraction' describes only the left side of the heart; explains that before deciding on treatment the team must find out whether the valve is worn, clotted or infected, hence the blood cultures and the swallowed-probe echo; asks about his past drug use without judgement and in confidence, says why it matters (infection risk, planning) and offers support; explains that the Heart Team will compare another operation with a catheter valve-in-valve; answers his worries about another operation and about his liver honestly, without false reassurance; obtains consent; after surgery explains anticoagulation, dental care with antibiotic cover, blood cultures before any antibiotic if he gets a fever, and hepatitis treatment; checks understanding by teach-back and leaves room for questions. Invents no result, risk figure or outcome the case does not record.

name.zh-CN: 甘护士

knowledge.zh-CN: 病房交班（ISBAR）：48岁男性，下肢水肿、活动后胸闷半年，经改善心功能治疗仍反复，今天收住病房；既往做过心脏瓣膜手术。病房床旁有监护仪和心电图机，治疗车上有留置针和常用药，护士站有病历终端；超声心动图机要从影像科推来，CT 和腹部超声在影像科做，血培养在床旁采血后送微生物室。复述医嘱并完成护理范围内的操作（称体重、记出入量、留置针、采血）；只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断。被问到生命体征、体重、出入量、用药或过敏时，如实说没有可以报告的记录，绝不报出数字。所有患者都按标准预防操作。
knowledge.en: Ward handover (ISBAR): a 48-year-old man admitted today with six months of leg swelling and chest tightness on exertion, recurring despite heart-failure treatment; previous heart-valve operation. At the bedside there are a monitor and the ECG machine, the treatment cart holds cannulas and the usual drugs, and the records terminal is at the nurses' station; the echo machine has to be brought from imaging, CT and abdominal ultrasound are done in imaging, and blood cultures are drawn at the bedside and sent to microbiology. Reads orders back and carries out nursing tasks (weights, fluid chart, cannula, bloods); reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses. Asked for vital signs, weight, fluid balance, medicines or allergies, says plainly there is nothing recorded to report — never gives a number. Standard precautions for every patient.

name.zh-CN: 骆医生（心内科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教（PEARLS），只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“换瓣多年后又出现反复的淤血，你首先想到什么？”“射血分数能告诉你右心的哪些情况，又说明不了什么？”“除了磨损，还有什么会让生物瓣失功？哪一种可能不用开刀？”“如果患者用过毒品，你的检查顺序和谈话方式会有什么不同？”“衰败的人工瓣该由谁决定怎么处理、多快决定？”“一位患者恢复得好，能说明一种术式更好吗？”。可以讲解 ESC/EACTS 2025 瓣膜病指南、ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南和 ASE 2024 人工瓣影像指南的相关原则；学员读到相应记录之后，可以对比记录的病程与现行做法。不提前说出诊断、任何决策的正确选项或学员尚未读到的记录内容；不补充病例中没有的资料（生命体征、查体、化验、跨瓣压差、右心功能、首次手术的原因和人工瓣型号、用毒品的细节，以及出院以后的情况都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Socratic preceptor (PEARLS) who asks only about information the learner already has, e.g. “Congestion that keeps returning years after a valve replacement — what comes first to mind?”, “What can an ejection fraction tell you about the right heart, and what can it not?”, “Apart from wear, what else can make a tissue valve fail — and which cause might need no operation?”, “If a patient has used drugs, what changes in the order of your tests and in how you talk with him?”, “Who decides how a failing prosthesis is treated, and how soon?”, “What can one patient's good recovery tell you about a technique?”. May explain the relevant principles of ESC/EACTS 2025 valvular heart disease, ESC 2023 endocarditis and ASE 2024 prosthetic valve imaging, and — once the learner has read the records — contrast the recorded course with current practice. Never states the diagnosis, any decision's correct option or the content of a record the learner has not read, and adds no data the case lacks (vital signs, examination, laboratory values, gradients, right-heart function, the cause of the first valve disease and the prosthesis model, the details of drug use and anything after discharge are not recorded).

name.zh-CN: 冯医生（心脏外科医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 心脏外科医生，参加心脏团队讨论。只解读学员已经读过的既往瓣膜手术记录、治疗方案讨论记录和后续病程记录：解释再次手术的难点（粘连、再次进胸的风险），以及外科再次置换与经导管瓣中瓣各自需要的条件；学员读过治疗方案讨论记录之后，再解释其中所记方案的原理、前提和外周体外循环的做法。不报告学员尚未读到的记录；不编造手术细节、取出的旧瓣膜所见、出血或并发症（都没有记录）；在学员读到出院记录之前不谈结局。
knowledge.en: Cardiac surgeon on the Heart Team. Interprets only the previous valve operation record, the treatment planning record and the subsequent course record once the learner has read them: the difficulties of a re-operation (adhesions, the risks of re-entry) and what redo surgical replacement and transcatheter valve-in-valve each require; once the learner has read the planning record, the principle and prerequisites of the approach it records and how its bypass is run through peripheral vessels. Never reports a record the learner has not read, and never invents operative details, explanted-valve findings, blood loss or complications (none is recorded); says nothing of the outcome before the learner has read the discharge record.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：三尖瓣生物瓣梗阻——从查明机制到再次置换
title.en: Debrief: an obstructed tricuspid bioprosthesis — from finding the mechanism to redo replacement

conclusion.zh-CN: 48岁男性，有乙肝、丙肝和既往使用毒品史，下肢水肿、活动后胸闷半年，经改善心功能治疗后反复。他的三尖瓣 22 年前因严重病变换成了生物瓣。超声心动图示三尖瓣生物瓣重度梗阻，左心室射血分数 54%——对男性属正常，却说明不了右心的情况。诊断：症状性三尖瓣生物瓣功能障碍（重度梗阻）伴体循环淤血。团队认为具备再次置换指征，在胸腔镜辅助、低温室颤停搏下完成再次三尖瓣置换（体外循环 182 分钟）；术后第 2 天拔管，第 3 天回普通病房，第 13 天出院。按现行指南（ESC/EACTS 2025；ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南），应先查明梗阻机制——用抗生素前采集血培养，做经食管超声或 CT——再由心脏团队及时在外科再次置换与经导管瓣中瓣之间做出决定。长期随访没有记录。
conclusion.en: A 48-year-old man with hepatitis B and C and past drug use had six months of leg swelling and exertional chest tightness, recurring despite heart-failure treatment. His tricuspid valve had been replaced with a bioprosthesis 22 years earlier. Echocardiography showed severe obstruction of the tricuspid bioprosthesis with an LVEF of 54 % — normal for a man, silent on the right heart. Diagnosis: symptomatic tricuspid bioprosthetic dysfunction (severe obstruction) with systemic venous congestion. The team judged redo replacement indicated and performed a thoracoscope-assisted redo tricuspid valve replacement under hypothermic ventricular fibrillatory arrest (bypass 182 minutes); he was extubated on day 2, back on the ward on day 3 and home on day 13. Today's answer (ESC/EACTS 2025; ESC 2023 endocarditis): establish the mechanism first — cultures before any antibiotic, TOE or CT — then a prompt Heart Team choice between redo surgery and valve-in-valve. No long-term follow-up is recorded.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 瓣膜置换术后出现反复的体循环淤血，首先要怀疑人工瓣功能障碍；第一项检查是带完整人工瓣多普勒评估的经胸超声心动图，而不是肝脏或冠状动脉检查。
keyReasoning.en: Recurrent systemic congestion after a valve replacement points first to the prosthesis; the first test is transthoracic echocardiography with a full prosthetic Doppler study, not a liver or coronary work-up.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 射血分数 54% 只说明左心室收缩正常；三尖瓣梗阻时，右心房压升高、下肢水肿和肝脏淤血可以与正常的左心室同时存在。
keyReasoning.en: An LVEF of 54 % shows only that the left ventricle contracts normally; an obstructed tricuspid valve raises right atrial pressure and causes leg swelling and liver congestion alongside a normal left ventricle.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: “重度梗阻”是描述，不是机制：结构性衰败、血栓、心内膜炎和血管翳的处理各不相同；他有人工瓣、以前用过毒品，再次干预前必须先排查感染和血栓。
keyReasoning.en: 'Severe obstruction' is a description, not a mechanism: wear, thrombus, endocarditis and pannus are treated differently, and with a prosthetic valve and past drug use, infection and thrombus must be excluded before reintervention.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 治疗后仍反复的症状说明药物已经不够；再次干预的时机和方式由心脏团队决定，转诊越晚，右心和肝肾付出的代价越大。
keyReasoning.en: Symptoms that return despite treatment mean medicine is no longer enough; the Heart Team decides the timing and type of reintervention, and the later the referral, the higher the price paid by the right heart, liver and kidneys.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 一位患者在术后第 13 天顺利出院，只能说明这种方法在他身上可行，不能说明它比其他方法更好或更耐久。
keyReasoning.en: One patient going home on postoperative day 13 shows that the approach was feasible for him; it cannot show that it is better or more durable than the alternatives.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单篇病例报告，本版依据 1.0.0 版提取的事实改写，尚未对照原文全文核对。它不能说明低温室颤停搏这一方法比其他方法更好，也不能说明远期效果。病例没有记录生命体征、查体、化验、跨瓣压差与右心功能、首次手术的原因和人工瓣型号、用毒品的细节、新植入瓣膜的类型、术后并发症和出院后的情况；决策、处置选项和评分是教学设计，不改变记录的病程。
boundaries.en: A single case report, re-authored here from the facts extracted for version 1.0.0 and not yet checked against the full article. It cannot show that hypothermic fibrillatory arrest is better than other approaches, nor anything about the long term. No vital signs, examination, laboratory values, gradients or right-heart function, cause of the first valve disease, prosthesis model, details of drug use, type of the new valve, postoperative complications or course after discharge are recorded; the decisions, intervention options and scoring are teaching design and do not change the recorded course.

unknowns.zh-CN: 各阶段的生命体征、体重和查体结果（颈静脉、水肿范围、肝脏、腹水、杂音、心律、手术瘢痕、注射痕迹）。
unknowns.en: Vital signs, weight and examination findings at any point (neck veins, extent of oedema, liver, ascites, murmurs, rhythm, scars, injection marks).

unknowns.zh-CN: 化验数值：肝肾功能、白蛋白、胆红素、凝血、血常规、NT-proBNP，乙肝、丙肝病毒学和 HIV 状态。
unknowns.en: Laboratory values: liver and kidney function, albumin, bilirubin, clotting, blood count, NT-proBNP, hepatitis B and C virology and HIV status.

unknowns.zh-CN: 超声心动图细节（跨瓣压差、有效瓣口面积、反流、右心室大小和功能、下腔静脉、肺动脉压、其他瓣膜、LVEF 测量方法），以及是否做过经食管超声、CT、冠状动脉评估和血培养。
unknowns.en: Echocardiographic detail (gradients, effective orifice area, regurgitation, right-ventricular size and function, IVC, pulmonary pressure, the other valves, the LVEF method), and whether TOE, CT, a coronary assessment or blood cultures were done.

unknowns.zh-CN: 第一次手术：三尖瓣病变的原因、手术入路、人工瓣型号和尺寸，以及此后是否抗凝。
unknowns.en: The first operation: the cause of the tricuspid disease, the approach, the prosthesis model and size, and any anticoagulation since.

unknowns.zh-CN: 用毒品的细节（种类、途径、最后一次使用、是否接受治疗），吸烟、饮酒、长期用药、过敏史，以及改善心功能治疗所用的药物和剂量。
unknowns.en: The details of his drug use (substance, route, last use, any treatment), smoking, alcohol, regular medicines, allergies, and the drugs and doses of his heart-failure treatment.

unknowns.zh-CN: 手术细节：切口、插管、温度、室颤如何处理、主动脉是否阻断、旧瓣膜所见、新瓣膜的类型和尺寸、排气、出血，以及团队选择这一方案的理由。
unknowns.en: The operation in detail: incisions, cannulation, temperature, how fibrillation was managed, whether the aorta was clamped, explanted-valve findings, the new valve's type and size, de-airing, blood loss, and the team's reasons for choosing the approach.

unknowns.zh-CN: 术后经过：抗凝方案、心律与传导、并发症、出院用药和出院前超声心动图，以及术后第 13 天出院以后的随访。
unknowns.en: The postoperative course: anticoagulation, rhythm and conduction, complications, discharge medicines and echocardiogram, and any follow-up after discharge on day 13.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 人工瓣梗阻要用多普勒量化：峰值和平均跨瓣压差、压力减半时间、速度时间积分比值，并与植入后的基线比较（ASE/SCMR/SCCT 2024 人工瓣影像指南）；ASE/EACVI 2015 的男性 LVEF 正常范围为 52%–72%，54% 正常，却不反映右心。记录与现行做法：本病例的超声只写了“重度梗阻”和射血分数，没有压差和右心功能——今天的报告应给出这些数值。
teachingPoints.en: Grade prosthetic obstruction by Doppler — peak and mean gradients, pressure half-time, the velocity-time-integral ratio — against the post-implant baseline (ASE/SCMR/SCCT 2024 prosthetic valve imaging); the ASE/EACVI 2015 normal LVEF for men is 52–72 %, so 54 % is normal and says nothing about the right heart. Then and now: his echo records only 'severe obstruction' and the LVEF, with no gradients or right-heart function; a report today should give both.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 再次干预前先定机制。生物瓣功能障碍可以是结构性衰败、血栓、心内膜炎或血管翳：疑有血栓时，经食管超声或 CT 证实后先抗凝，可能免于手术（ESC/EACTS 2025）；疑有心内膜炎时，用抗生素前采集三套血培养，再做经食管超声，按 Duke-ISCVID 2023 标准判断（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）。记录与现行做法：本病例没有记录血培养、经食管超声或 CT 是否做过。
teachingPoints.en: Fix the mechanism before reintervening. Bioprosthetic dysfunction can be wear, thrombus, endocarditis or pannus: suspected thrombus, once confirmed by TOE or CT, is anticoagulated first and may need no operation (ESC/EACTS 2025); suspected endocarditis needs three sets of blood cultures before any antibiotic, then TOE, judged by the Duke-ISCVID 2023 criteria (ESC 2023 endocarditis). Then and now: whether cultures, TOE or CT were done is not recorded here.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 策略由心脏团队决定。外科再次置换与经导管瓣中瓣各有前提：瓣中瓣取决于原瓣的型号和内径，适合外科风险高的患者，48 岁的患者还要考虑耐久性；复杂的再干预应在有经验的中心进行（ESC/EACTS 2025）。三尖瓣病变要在右心衰竭和肝肾损害加重之前处理。记录与现行做法：报告记录了团队认为具备再次置换指征，但没有记录比较过哪些方案、怎样评估风险。
teachingPoints.en: The Heart Team sets the strategy. Redo surgery and transcatheter valve-in-valve each have prerequisites: valve-in-valve depends on the old valve's model and inner diameter and suits patients at high surgical risk, and at 48 durability matters; complex reinterventions belong in experienced centres (ESC/EACTS 2025). Tricuspid disease should be treated before right-heart failure and liver and kidney injury advance. Then and now: the report records that the team judged redo replacement indicated, not which options it compared or how it assessed risk.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 报告的术式——胸腔镜辅助、低温室颤停搏下再次三尖瓣置换——常用于避免在再次手术中游离和阻断主动脉。前提是没有明显的主动脉瓣反流，要了解有无卵圆孔未闭，复跳前彻底排气，并评估外周插管血管和冠状动脉（ESC/EACTS 2025 瓣膜手术前的冠状动脉评估）。一位患者体外循环 182 分钟、术后第 2 天拔管、第 3 天回普通病房、第 13 天出院，只证明可行，不证明更优或更耐久；报告的讨论本身也强调排气和气栓风险，并承认单例和缺乏长期资料的局限。
teachingPoints.en: The reported technique — thoracoscope-assisted redo tricuspid replacement under hypothermic ventricular fibrillatory arrest — is used to avoid dissecting and clamping the aorta at a re-operation. It needs no significant aortic regurgitation, knowledge of any patent foramen ovale, thorough de-airing before the heart ejects, suitable vessels for peripheral cannulation and a coronary assessment (ESC/EACTS 2025 before valve surgery). One patient — bypass 182 minutes, extubated on day 2, on the ward on day 3, home on day 13 — shows feasibility, not superiority or durability; the report's own discussion stresses de-airing and air embolism and the limits of a single case without long-term data.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 换瓣之后的整体照护：按植入瓣膜的类型抗凝（机械瓣终身；外科生物瓣术后早期个体化抗栓，三尖瓣位通常为前 3 个月的维生素 K 拮抗剂；ESC/EACTS 2025），出院前做基线超声，监测房室传导阻滞；人工瓣属心内膜炎高危，高危牙科操作前预防用抗生素并保持口腔卫生（ESC 2023 心内膜炎指南）；乙肝长期抑制、丙肝可以治愈（中华医学会 2022 年乙肝、丙肝防治指南）；不带评判地提供成瘾支持和减害。记录与现行做法：本病例没有记录新瓣膜类型、出院用药和随访。
teachingPoints.en: Whole-patient care after the replacement: anticoagulation by valve type (lifelong for a mechanical valve; after a surgical bioprosthesis, individualised early antithrombotic treatment, in the tricuspid position usually a vitamin K antagonist for the first 3 months; ESC/EACTS 2025), a baseline echo before discharge and watching for AV block; endocarditis prevention for a high-risk prosthetic valve — antibiotic prophylaxis before high-risk dental procedures and good oral hygiene (ESC 2023 endocarditis); long-term suppression of hepatitis B and cure of hepatitis C (Chinese Medical Association 2022 hepatitis B and C guidelines); and addiction support and harm reduction without judgement. Then and now: the new valve's type, his discharge medicines and follow-up are not recorded.

unknowns.zh-CN: 各阶段的生命体征、体重和查体结果（颈静脉、水肿范围、肝脏、腹水、杂音、心律、手术瘢痕、注射痕迹）。
unknowns.en: Vital signs, weight and examination findings at any point (neck veins, extent of oedema, liver, ascites, murmurs, rhythm, scars, injection marks).

unknowns.zh-CN: 化验数值：肝肾功能、白蛋白、胆红素、凝血、血常规、NT-proBNP，乙肝、丙肝病毒学和 HIV 状态。
unknowns.en: Laboratory values: liver and kidney function, albumin, bilirubin, clotting, blood count, NT-proBNP, hepatitis B and C virology and HIV status.

unknowns.zh-CN: 超声心动图细节（跨瓣压差、有效瓣口面积、反流、右心室大小和功能、下腔静脉、肺动脉压、其他瓣膜、LVEF 测量方法），以及是否做过经食管超声、CT、冠状动脉评估和血培养。
unknowns.en: Echocardiographic detail (gradients, effective orifice area, regurgitation, right-ventricular size and function, IVC, pulmonary pressure, the other valves, the LVEF method), and whether TOE, CT, a coronary assessment or blood cultures were done.

unknowns.zh-CN: 第一次手术：三尖瓣病变的原因、手术入路、人工瓣型号和尺寸，以及此后是否抗凝。
unknowns.en: The first operation: the cause of the tricuspid disease, the approach, the prosthesis model and size, and any anticoagulation since.

unknowns.zh-CN: 用毒品的细节（种类、途径、最后一次使用、是否接受治疗），吸烟、饮酒、长期用药、过敏史，以及改善心功能治疗所用的药物和剂量。
unknowns.en: The details of his drug use (substance, route, last use, any treatment), smoking, alcohol, regular medicines, allergies, and the drugs and doses of his heart-failure treatment.

unknowns.zh-CN: 手术细节：切口、插管、温度、室颤如何处理、主动脉是否阻断、旧瓣膜所见、新瓣膜的类型和尺寸、排气、出血，以及团队选择这一方案的理由。
unknowns.en: The operation in detail: incisions, cannulation, temperature, how fibrillation was managed, whether the aorta was clamped, explanted-valve findings, the new valve's type and size, de-airing, blood loss, and the team's reasons for choosing the approach.

unknowns.zh-CN: 术后经过：抗凝方案、心律与传导、并发症、出院用药和出院前超声心动图，以及术后第 13 天出院以后的随访。
unknowns.en: The postoperative course: anticoagulation, rhythm and conduction, complications, discharge medicines and echocardiogram, and any follow-up after discharge on day 13.
